description: Statistics of English manga for a year, or one month of it: new English volumes released per month and per publisher, the median and average months from the Japanese release to the first English edition per publisher, the fastest and slowest series, and the series that started and finished in English. A volume counts once, in the month of its first English edition. Defaults to the latest year.

month.description: A month from 1 to 12 for the figures of one month. Leave out for the whole year.

year.description: The year, like 2026. Default the latest year with a report.

name: get_report
title: English Manga Report: release statistics
